description: USFS RoadCore — the FULL National Forest road inventory (administrative, closed, decommissioned included). Legality-agnostic grey context under the MVUM layer: designation is 'unassessed' on every feature and the client must never render it green or imply it is drivable.
notes: Field names verified 2026-08-03 against EDW_RoadBasic_01/0: rte_cn, id, name, symbol_code, symbol_name, surface_type, oper_maint_level, objective_maint_level, openforuseto, route_status, jurisdiction, gis_miles. admin_org/managing_org are numeric org codes and deliberately dropped. minzoom 6 (not 4) — the full inventory is too dense to serve lower. Client renders grey #8A8F98, thinner than MVUM, NEVER green (automated client test).
